ui.lang.label: Choose your language
ui.location.label: Set your state and city
ui.location.help: Tell us your state and city so we can show the offices and portals that serve you. We keep this only in a small cookie on your device.
ui.rail.label: Browse by topic
ui.rail.title: Browse by topic
ui.home.h1: Tell us what happened. We'll show you the right door.
ui.home.lead: Describe your problem in your own words. Raasta shows the free and peaceful step first, then the office that can help.
ui.home.placeholder: For example: my landlord has not returned my deposit for three months.
ui.home.privacy: Please do not type Aadhaar, bank or OTP numbers. We never ask for them.
ui.home.prefer: Prefer questions? Answer a few quick ones
ui.how.1.title: Tell us
ui.how.1.body: Write what happened in your own words, or answer a few short questions.
ui.how.2.title: See the right door
ui.how.2.body: We show the first peaceful step, the office that can act, and why.
ui.how.3.title: File or send
ui.how.3.body: Get a ready letter or form to check, sign and send, with the office address.
ui.free.body: Many disputes can be settled without a court case. A Lok Adalat is a people's forum where both sides try to agree on a fair settlement, and it is free. Tele-Law and free legal aid can connect you to a lawyer if you qualify.
ui.fact.daksh: In a DAKSH survey, 74% of people said they first turn to friends and family when they face a dispute.
ui.faq.1.q: Is Raasta a lawyer or a government website?
ui.faq.1.a: No. Raasta is an independent guide. It explains which authority to approach and how, using public government rules. It is not legal advice.
ui.faq.2.a: No. Raasta is free to use, and it shows the free and peaceful options first.
ui.faq.3.a: Please do not type your Aadhaar, bank account or card numbers, or any OTP. Raasta never asks for them.
ui.faq.4.q: Does it work on an old phone or a slow connection?
ui.faq.4.a: Yes. The main steps are simple forms and pages, so they work on older phones and slow connections.
ui.help.lead: Choose the kind of problem you have. Each topic leads to a few short questions and then the right door.
ui.notfound.title: This door doesn't exist.
ui.notfound.lead: Here are the ones that do.
ui.emergency.lead: If money has just left your account through UPI or a card, act quickly. The first hour matters most.
ui.emergency.upi_h2: If you were cheated through UPI or a card
ui.emergency.step1.title: Call 1930 within the golden hour.
ui.emergency.step1.body: The sooner you call, the better the chance that the money can be held back.
ui.emergency.step2.title: Report the fraud online.
ui.emergency.step2.body: File a complaint on the national cyber crime portal:
ui.emergency.step3.title: Write to your bank within 3 working days.
ui.emergency.step3.body: A written intimation to your bank protects your position. Keep your transaction ID, screenshots and the number that contacted you.
ui.emergency.never_share: Never share an OTP, PIN or card number with anyone, even if they say they are from your bank.

ui.act.heading: Ways to act on this
ui.act.drafted_note: Raasta drafts the words for you. Nothing is filed until you press send or submit yourself.
ui.act.api_note_demo: Demo sandbox. Nothing is sent to a real municipal system.
ui.act.api_note: This sends your complaint to your city grievance system. You get a reference number.
ui.act.prefill: Open the portal with your details filled in
ui.act.prefill_note: The portal opens in a new tab. You check the details and submit there.
ui.act.whatsapp: Open WhatsApp with a drafted message
ui.act.whatsapp_note: Drafted for you. You press send in WhatsApp.
ui.act.email_trimmed: The message was shortened to fit a link. Attach the full letter you downloaded.
ui.act.post_note: Drafted for you. You post it yourself and keep the receipt.
ui.act.guide_note: Plain steps for the official site, with your drafted text.
ui.act.tray_note: Open the official site in a new tab, then paste each box into the matching field. Field names differ by site.
ui.act.k_tray: Copy and paste into the portal
ui.res.street_label: Your route: first step, then the right door, then other doors
ui.res.checklist_note: Tick each item as you collect it.
ui.res.bank_letter: Prepare your letter to the bank
ui.guide.minutes: This usually takes about {n} minutes (an estimate from the number of steps).
ui.guide.draft: Your drafted text (copy and paste it here)
ui.guide.no_steps: We do not have written steps for this site yet. Open the official site and follow its own instructions.
ui.guide.after_note: Save the reference number you get and write it down. Raasta does not store it for you.
ui.guide.next_door: If you do not hear back
ui.guide.offline: If you prefer to go in person
ui.guide.offline_note: Take your documents in original plus two photocopies, and ask for a stamped receipt.
ui.doc.lead: Check the details, fix anything that is wrong, and leave blanks you do not know. Raasta never invents a detail.
ui.doc.privacy: Your details are used once to build the file. They are not saved or logged.
ui.label.guidance: Send important letters by Speed Post or Registered Post A.D. with acknowledgement. Ask for the receipt and keep it as proof of posting.
ui.label.article: Write the article number from your receipt on your copy. You can use it to track the letter on the India Post website.

ui.dir.no_address: We do not have a street address for this office. Use the links below or call first.
